item.title: Tarun Souradeep
item.description: Tarun Souradeep is an Indian astrophysicist and cosmologist. He is the Director of the Raman Research Institute (RRI) in Bengaluru. His research includes work on the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) and participation in efforts to develop gravitational-wave astronomy in India, particularly through the LIGO-India project.
